title: Recall a familiar person without importing private conversations
requirements: In private, recognize the same QQ identity using at most three bounded, active public self-reported preferences from allowlisted groups; exclude group discussion, relationships, other people, personal visibility, private sources and unsupported or expired facts.
No private-to-group propagation or group context injection. Sources remain authoritative; revoked or deleted sources cannot be reimported through caches or copied global profiles.

Chat users cannot enable or disable internal memory mechanics. Familiarity is automatic; backend-only controls remain inaccessible from chat or Skills. Former switch phrases follow normal private admission and never bypass daily cost quota or produce configuration acknowledgements.
Wire medium-trust dynamic context in bootstrap; shared facts do not alter stable prefix and ordinary chat behavior remains unchanged.
